title: chant workspace records amend output
description: What `chant workspace records amend <id> --kind <kind file> --set <file|->` prints (#2670): the record's path and id and the top-level fields the amendment changed, or the reason it wrote nothing. Version 1 of the write contract for records. The command writes one file or none and never commits. Readers ignore fields they do not know; a field is only ever added within a version. The error codes are a closed list, each in the one closed list of `reason-codes.ts`. Contract version 1 of this document is written by chant 0.86.0 and newer.

result.description: The record was written, or would be with --dry-run. Exit code 0.

schema.description: The `$id` of the schema the record was validated against.

file.description: The kind file, relative to the repository root, with / separators.

path.description: The record file, relative to the repository root (the working directory outside git), with / separators.

changed.description: The top-level fields whose value differs from the record as it was, in the record's order, with seal last when the author seal was written or removed (#2688). Empty when the fields set change nothing, and then nothing is written.

seal.description:
Added in contract 1 by #2688. With --sign only: the author seal written into the record's top-level seal field, an ssh signature by the key given (or git's user.signingkey) over <id>
<digest>
<author>
<state>, in the ssh-keygen namespace chant-record. The author is the kind's reviews.decider field (decided_by for decisions), and the digest is the record's digest by the digest rule, which leaves the seal field out. The write does not check the key against the signers file; chant workspace records reports whether the seal verifies.

signer.description: The record's author, as its reviews.decider field names them.

key.description: The fingerprint of the key that signed, read back from the signature.

sealDropped.description: Added in contract 1 by #2688. Present when the record carried an author seal, the amendment moved its digest and --sign was not given: the seal no longer covers the text, so it was removed, and this says so. changed then lists seal.

dryRun.description: True when --dry-run was given and nothing was written.

warnings.description: The written record's warnings, as chant workspace records reports them. A warning never refuses a write.

text.description: With --dry-run only: the whole text of the file the command would write.

message.description: What was wrong, and what to do instead when there is something, such as writing a new record that supersedes this one.
